metadata.description: Evaluates crema-breakdown switching model with fixed tau (5.5 min) on coffee cooling datasets, comparing against Newton baseline and free-transition models using out-of-sample RMSE, BIC, and drinkable-temperature crossing error with bootstrap CIs.

examples.input: Fit five coffee-cooling models (Newton, piecewise, coupled ODE, Bayesian change-point, flux-crossover) to the kurzweg_1988 dataset, fit on first 80%, evaluate OOS on last 20%, compute BIC and predicted time-to-drinkable (50°C crossing).
